svg.title: A failure can become a repair task
svg.desc: A loop: a workflow fails on main, a webhook routes the failure into a repair task where an agent investigates, the agent proposes a fix and the checks run again, and the fix still goes through review and merge before it reaches main. An upstream sync from Yarden's fork feeds into main. The centre notes that this is not automatic recovery.

g.title: upstream sync — from Yarden’s fork + tests

svg.text: the proposal still has to pass
